en: on or into a ship, plane, or train
toeic: Passengers should be aboard the flight thirty minutes before departure.
toeic_zh: 乘客應在起飛前三十分鐘登機。

en: a vehicle with wings that flies
toeic: Please turn off your phone before the airplane takes off.
toeic_zh: 飛機起飛前請關閉您的手機。

en: a place where planes take off and land
simple: I am going to the airport.
toeic: A shuttle bus runs between the hotel and the airport.
toeic_zh: 接駁巴士往返於飯店與機場之間。

en: available instead of the usual one
toeic: Please use an alternate route because the bridge is closed.
toeic_zh: 由於橋梁封閉，請改走替代路線。

en: not exact but close to the real number
simple: The approximate cost is ten dollars.
toeic: The approximate delivery time is three to five business days.
toeic_zh: 預估送達時間約為三至五個工作天。

en: A car with a driver that you pay to ride.
simple: We took a cab to the hotel.
toeic: Please call a cab to take the visitors to the airport.
toeic_zh: 請叫一輛計程車送訪客去機場。

en: A box with bars used to keep animals in.
simple: The bird is in a cage.
toeic: The shipment included a cage for transporting small animals.
toeic_zh: 這批貨物包含一個運送小動物的籠子。

en: The person in charge of a ship, plane or team.
toeic: The captain announced a delay because of bad weather.
toeic_zh: 機長宣布因天候不佳而延誤。

en: goods carried by a ship, plane, or truck
toeic: All cargo must be inspected before it is loaded onto the aircraft.
toeic_zh: 所有貨物在裝上飛機前都必須經過檢查。

en: a company that transports goods
simple: Our carrier delivers packages to all regions.
simple_zh: 我們的承運人將包裹送到所有地區。
toeic: We use multiple carriers to ensure reliable and timely deliveries.
toeic_zh: 我們使用多個承運人以確保可靠和及時的交付。

en: A small vehicle pushed by hand to carry things.
simple: Put the milk in the cart.
toeic: Items in your online cart will be saved for seven days.
toeic_zh: 您線上購物車中的商品將保留七天。

en: a cardboard box used for packing goods
simple: He carried a carton of milk.
toeic: Each carton contains twenty-four units and weighs about ten kilograms.
toeic_zh: 每個紙箱裝有二十四件，重約十公斤。

en: A unit of length equal to one hundredth of a meter.
simple: The pen is ten centimeter long.
toeic: The box must not exceed fifty centimeter in width.
toeic_zh: 箱子的寬度不得超過五十公分。

en: an official document certifying something
simple: This product has a certificate of authenticity.
toeic: Quality certificates prove that products meet industry standards.
toeic_zh: 品質證書證明產品符合行業標準。

en: To put things into groups by type.
simple_zh: 我們依主題為書籍分類。
toeic: Please classify these documents as confidential or public.
toeic_zh: 請將這些文件分類為機密或公開。

en: A person who travels regularly to work.
toeic: Each commuter will get a discount on monthly train passes.
toeic_zh: 每位通勤者都可享有月票折扣。

en: A separate space inside a larger container or vehicle.
simple: Put your bag in the compartment.
simple_zh: 把你的包包放進置物櫃。
toeic: Store large bags in the overhead compartment.
toeic_zh: 請把大型行李放在上方行李櫃。

en: A new problem that makes a situation harder.
toeic: A customs complication delayed the shipment by three days.
toeic_zh: 報關上的麻煩讓貨物延遲了三天。

en: A person who leads an orchestra or checks tickets on a train.
toeic: The conductor will lead the orchestra in tonight's concert.
toeic_zh: 指揮將在今晚的音樂會中帶領樂團。

en: A crowded condition, especially of traffic.
toeic: Heavy congestion on the highway delayed our delivery trucks.
toeic_zh: 高速公路嚴重壅塞延誤了我們的送貨卡車。

en: a batch of goods sent or delivered to someone
simple_zh: 這批託運貨物搭火車抵達了。
toeic: Each consignment must be signed for by a manager.
toeic_zh: 每批託運貨物都必須由經理簽收。
family: consign (v); consignee (n); consignor (n); on consignment 寄售

en: seeking expert advice
toeic: Expert consultation improves supply chain strategy.
toeic_zh: 專家諮詢改進供應鏈策略。

en: a structure designed to hold goods
toeic: Shipping containers are standardized for efficient cargo handling.
toeic_zh: 運送容器標準化以進行高效的貨物搬運。

en: relating to a continent
toeic: The hotel offers a free continental breakfast every morning.
toeic_zh: 這間飯店每天早上提供免費的歐陸式早餐。

en: expensive or causing a big loss
toeic: A delay in delivery could be very costly for our company.
toeic_zh: 交貨延誤可能讓我們公司付出高昂代價。

en: a person who delivers messages or parcels
simple: The courier arrived with your package.
simple_zh: 快遞員帶著您的包裹到達了。
toeic: Our couriers offer same-day delivery for urgent shipments.
toeic_zh: 我們的快遞員為緊急貨運提供當日交付。

en: a business that sells cars for a company
toeic: He works at a car dealership downtown.
toeic_zh: 他在市中心的汽車經銷商工作。

en: able to be trusted to do what is needed
toeic: We are looking for a dependable supplier with fast delivery times.
toeic_zh: 我們正在尋找交貨快速且可靠的供應商。

en: the state of needing something or someone
simple: His dependence on coffee is high.
toeic: The firm is reducing its dependence on a single supplier.
toeic_zh: 該公司正減少對單一供應商的依賴。

en: to throw away something not needed
toeic: Customers should discard any damaged items and request a replacement.
toeic_zh: 顧客應丟棄任何損壞的物品並要求更換。

en: a difference or inconsistency
simple: There is a discrepancy in the inventory.
toeic: Discrepancies between orders and receipts must be investigated.
toeic_zh: 必須調查訂單和收據之間的差異。

en: to send out or arrange for delivery
toeic: Orders are dispatched to customers within 24 hours.
toeic_zh: 訂單在24小時內派遣給客戶。

en: to stop something from continuing normally
toeic: Heavy snow may disrupt train services across the region.
toeic_zh: 大雪可能使整個地區的火車服務中斷。

en: disturbance or problems with normal operations
toeic: Supply chain disruptions require rapid response and adaptation.
toeic_zh: 供應鏈中斷需要快速反應和適應。

en: a company that distributes goods to retailers
simple: Our distributor ships products to stores nationwide.
simple_zh: 我們的分銷商向全國各地的商店運送產品。
toeic: We work with several distributors to reach different regional markets.
toeic_zh: 我們與多個分銷商合作以達到不同的地區市場。

en: a place where ships or trucks load and unload goods
simple: The truck is at the dock.
toeic: Please direct all deliveries to the dock at the rear of the building.
toeic_zh: 請將所有送貨引導到大樓後方的裝卸平台。

en: a sudden strong shaking of the ground
toeic: The earthquake damaged several buildings near the factory.
toeic_zh: 地震損壞了工廠附近的幾棟建築。

en: to speed up or hurry a process
simple: Can you expedite this order for me?
simple_zh: 你能為我加急這份訂單嗎？
toeic: Customers can pay extra to expedite shipping for urgent deliveries.
toeic_zh: 客戶可以支付額外費用以加急運送緊急交付。

en: the end of the time a thing can be used
toeic: The expiration date of the contract is December 31.
toeic_zh: 合約的到期日是十二月三十一日。

en: a boat that carries people across water
simple: We took the ferry to the island.
toeic: The ferry to the island departs every hour.
toeic_zh: 前往小島的渡輪每小時開出一班。

en: a group of vehicles or ships owned by one company
simple: The company has a large fleet.
simple_zh: 這家公司有一支龐大的車隊。
toeic: The delivery company is adding ten electric vans to its fleet.
toeic_zh: 這家配送公司正在為其車隊增添十輛電動貨車。

en: ability to adjust to changing conditions
toeic: Supply chain flexibility enables quick response to demand changes.
toeic_zh: 供應鏈靈活性使快速響應需求變化成為可能。

en: a fine powder used to make bread and cakes
simple: We need flour for the cake.
toeic: The bakery orders flour in bulk every week.
toeic_zh: 這間麵包店每週大量訂購麵粉。

en: shoes, boots, and other things worn on feet
simple: The store sells footwear for kids.
toeic: The shop offers a wide selection of footwear at low prices.
toeic_zh: 這家店以低價提供各式鞋類。

en: by good luck
toeic: Fortunately, the shipment arrived before the deadline.
toeic_zh: 幸運的是，貨物在截止日前送達了。

en: goods transported by vehicle, ship, or plane
simple: The freight cost is very high this month.
simple_zh: 這個月的貨運成本很高。
toeic: Freight charges are typically calculated based on weight and distance.
toeic_zh: 貨運費用通常根據重量和距離計算。

en: a ship or plane that carries goods
toeic: A freighter will deliver the machinery to the port next week.
toeic_zh: 一艘貨船下週會將機器運送到港口。

en: to put furniture in a room, or to supply
simple_zh: 他們為新辦公室添購家具。
toeic: The landlord will furnish the apartment with a desk and chairs.
toeic_zh: 房東會為公寓配置書桌和椅子。

en: a unit for measuring liquid
simple: We bought a gallon of milk.
toeic: The truck holds about two hundred gallons of fuel.
toeic_zh: 這輛卡車可裝約兩百加侖的燃料。

en: fuel used in cars
toeic: Rising gasoline prices have increased delivery costs.
toeic_zh: 汽油價格上漲提高了運送成本。

en: things that are made or grown to be sold
simple: The shop has many goods on sale.
simple_zh: 這家店有很多特價商品。
toeic: The goods will be shipped from our central warehouse this afternoon.
toeic_zh: 這批貨品將於今天下午從我們的中央倉庫出貨。

en: a small unit of weight
toeic: The package weighs about five hundred grams.
toeic_zh: 這個包裹重約五百公克。

en: a store or goods for food and household items
simple: I buy milk at the grocery.
toeic: The grocery chain plans to open ten new stores next year.
toeic_zh: 這家連鎖雜貨店計畫明年開設十家新分店。

en: dangerous to people or the environment
simple_zh: 那個箱子裝著危險物品。
toeic: Shipping hazardous materials requires special packaging and labeling.
toeic_zh: 危險物品運輸需要特殊的包裝與標示。

en: a large public road between cities
simple: The highway is very busy today.
toeic: The new highway will shorten the delivery time to the port.
toeic_zh: 新公路將縮短送貨到港口的時間。

en: the amount of water in the air
toeic: Keep the humidity low in the warehouse to protect the goods.
toeic_zh: 請保持倉庫低濕度以保護貨品。

en: covered with ice or very cold
toeic: Drivers should be careful because the highway is icy this morning.
toeic_zh: 由於今早公路結冰，駕駛人應小心。

en: low in price
toeic: We offer an inexpensive way to ship small packages overseas.
toeic_zh: 我們提供寄送小型包裹到海外的廉價方式。

en: colored liquid used for writing or printing
toeic: Please order more ink for the office printer.
toeic_zh: 請為辦公室印表機多訂購一些墨水。

en: to examine something carefully
simple: We inspect all goods before accepting them.
simple_zh: 我們在接受所有商品前進行檢查。
toeic: Quality inspectors examine each shipment to ensure it meets specifications.
toeic_zh: 品質檢查員檢查每份貨運以確保符合規格。

en: not enough
toeic: The loan was refused because of insufficient funds.
toeic_zh: 貸款因資金不足而被拒絕。

en: in or between many countries
simple_zh: 這位歌手在國際上很有名。
toeic: The company sells its products internationally through local distributors.
toeic_zh: 該公司透過當地經銷商向國際銷售產品。

en: a place where two roads cross
toeic: The hotel is located at the intersection of Main Street and Oak Avenue.
toeic_zh: 飯店位於主街與橡樹大道的交叉口。

en: sweet fruit spread, or a blocked line of traffic
simple_zh: 我喜歡在麵包上塗果醬。
toeic: A traffic jam delayed the delivery truck by an hour.
toeic_zh: 交通堵塞使送貨卡車延誤了一小時。

en: a fast airplane with powerful engines
toeic: The executives will travel on a private jet to the conference.
toeic_zh: 主管們將搭乘私人噴射機前往會議。

en: A unit of weight equal to 1,000 grams
toeic: Shipping costs five dollars per kilogram.
toeic_zh: 運費每公斤五美元。

en: A unit of distance equal to 1,000 meters
simple: The school is one kilometer from here.
toeic: The factory is only one kilometer from the airport.
toeic_zh: 工廠距離機場只有一公里。

en: A narrow road or a section of a wide road
toeic: The right lane will be closed for road repairs.
toeic_zh: 右側車道將因道路維修而封閉。

en: A unit for measuring liquid
simple: I drink one liter of water a day.
toeic: This tank holds one liter of fuel.
toeic_zh: 這個油箱可裝一公升的燃料。

en: In or near the place where you live
toeic: The products are made locally to reduce shipping costs.
toeic_zh: 這些產品在當地製造以降低運費。

en: A person who carries messages or packages
toeic: A messenger will deliver the contract to your office today.
toeic_zh: 信差今天會把合約送到您的辦公室。

en: A two-wheeled vehicle with an engine
simple: He rides a motorcycle to work.
toeic: Motorcycle parking is available behind the building.
toeic_zh: 大樓後方設有機車停車位。

en: covering the whole country
toeic: The retailer launched a nationwide delivery service last month.
toeic_zh: 這家零售商上個月推出了全國配送服務。

en: To get something
simple: You can obtain a form at the desk.
simple_zh: 你可以在櫃檯取得表格。
toeic: Visitors must obtain a permit before entering the site.
toeic_zh: 訪客進入現場前必須取得許可證。

en: happening or delivered the next day
toeic: Overnight delivery services command premium shipping rates.
toeic_zh: 隔夜交付服務收取高級運送費率。

en: to pay more than is needed
simple: I did not overpay for the room.
toeic: The company refused to overpay for the used equipment.
toeic_zh: 公司拒絕為二手設備付出過高的價錢。

en: a package or bundle of goods
toeic: Parcel delivery services handle small to medium-sized packages.
toeic_zh: 包裹交付服務處理中等規模的包裹。

en: not complete; only a part
toeic: The client received a partial refund for the damaged goods.
toeic_zh: 客戶因貨品受損取得部分退款。

en: not completely; in part
toeic: The warehouse was partially damaged by the storm.
toeic_zh: 倉庫被暴風雨部分損毀。

en: to punish someone for breaking a rule
toeic: The contract will penalize the supplier for late delivery.
toeic_zh: 合約會對延遲交貨的供應商處以罰則。

en: the cost of sending a letter or package by mail
simple: The postage costs two dollars here.
toeic: The price of the catalog does not include postage and handling.
toeic_zh: 目錄價格不含郵資與手續費。

en: relating to mail
toeic: Please include your postal code on the order form.
toeic_zh: 請在訂購單上填寫郵遞區號。

en: a person or company that supplies something
toeic: The service provider will upgrade our network tonight.
toeic_zh: 服務供應商今晚會升級我們的網路。

en: a person who buys something
toeic: The purchaser must pay the full amount within ten days.
toeic_zh: 買方必須在十天內付清全額。

en: a track for trains
simple: The railway is near my house.
toeic: The new railway will connect the port to the city.
toeic_zh: 這條新鐵路將連接港口與市區。

en: a partial refund or discount
simple: The manufacturer offers a rebate on this product.
simple_zh: 製造商對該產品提供回扣。
toeic: Volume rebates reward customers for purchasing in larger quantities.
toeic_zh: 數量回扣獎勵以更大數量購買的客戶。

en: the part that is left
simple: I will eat the remainder later.
toeic: The remainder of the balance is due by the end of the month.
toeic_zh: 餘額須於月底前付清。

en: the act of taking something away
toeic: Snow removal on the parking lot begins early in the morning.
toeic_zh: 停車場的除雪作業一大早就開始。

en: to continue an agreement or card for a new period
simple: I need to renew my card.
toeic: The two companies agreed to renew the contract for another year.
toeic_zh: 兩家公司同意再續約一年。
family: renewal (n); renewable (adj); renew a contract 續約

en: something new that takes the place of another thing
simple: I need a replacement for this cup.
simple_zh: 我需要這個杯子的替換品。
toeic: We will send a free replacement if the item arrives damaged.
toeic_zh: 如果商品到貨時受損，我們會免費寄送替換品。

en: the place where a person lives
toeic: Please send the package to my residence instead of the office.
toeic_zh: 請把包裹寄到我的住所而非辦公室。

en: a person or business that sells to the public
toeic: The retailer plans to open ten new stores this year.
toeic_zh: 這家零售商計畫今年開設十家新店。

en: a person who rides a bike, horse or vehicle
toeic: Bus riders can now pay with a mobile app.
toeic_zh: 公車乘客現在可以用手機應用程式付款。

en: a car with a separate trunk and four doors
toeic: We would like to rent a sedan for three days.
toeic_zh: 我們想租一輛轎車三天。

en: a person who sends a message or package
toeic: If the sender is unknown, do not open the attachment.
toeic_zh: 若寄件人不明，請勿開啟附件。

en: apart from each other
toeic: The items will be shipped separately from the main order.
toeic_zh: 這些商品將與主要訂單分開出貨。

en: a lack or deficiency of something
toeic: Supply chain disruptions create material shortages.
toeic_zh: 供應鏈中斷造成材料短缺。

en: a detailed description of requirements
toeic: Purchase orders include detailed specifications for quality and performance.
toeic_zh: 採購訂單包括品質和性能的詳細規格。

en: a pile of things on top of each other
simple: A stack of books is on the desk.
toeic: There is a stack of invoices waiting to be processed.
toeic_zh: 有一疊發票等待處理。

en: a small label that sticks to things
toeic: Place the price sticker on each item before display.
toeic_zh: 陳列前請在每件商品貼上價格貼紙。

en: a room where things are kept
simple: The boxes are in the storeroom.
toeic: Extra paper is kept in the storeroom on the second floor.
toeic_zh: 備用紙張存放在二樓的儲藏室。

en: a bag for carrying clothes when traveling
toeic: Please keep your suitcase with you at all times.
toeic_zh: 請隨時將您的行李箱帶在身邊。

en: a large store that sells food and goods
toeic: The supermarket is open until midnight on weekends.
toeic_zh: 這家超市週末營業到午夜。

en: a small label attached to something
toeic: Each item must have a security tag before it goes on display.
toeic_zh: 每件商品陳列前都必須貼上防盜標籤。

en: money paid to use a road or bridge
toeic: The toll on this bridge is five dollars.
toeic_zh: 這座橋的通行費是五美元。

en: a unit of weight equal to 1,000 kilograms
toeic: The factory ships fifty tons of steel each week.
toeic_zh: 這家工廠每週運送五十噸鋼材。

en: powder used in a printer or copier
toeic: Please order new toner for the copy machine.
toeic_zh: 請為影印機訂購新的碳粉。

en: to pull a vehicle with another vehicle
simple: They had to tow my car.
toeic: Cars parked here will be towed at the owner's expense.
toeic_zh: 停在此處的車輛將被拖吊，費用由車主負擔。

en: a person who goes on a trip
toeic: Business travelers can check in at the express counter.
toeic_zh: 商務旅客可在快速櫃檯辦理登機。

en: Not thought likely to happen.
simple_zh: 我們收到一份意外的禮物。
toeic: An unexpected delay forced us to reschedule the shipment.
toeic_zh: 一個意外的延誤迫使我們重新安排出貨。

en: Not able to be trusted or depended on.
toeic: The supplier proved unreliable, so we switched vendors.
toeic_zh: 該供應商不可靠，所以我們換了廠商。

en: Not used yet.
toeic: Unused items may be returned within thirty days for a refund.
toeic_zh: 未使用的商品可在三十天內退貨退款。

en: to confirm the correctness or accuracy of something
toeic: Orders are validated before processing to prevent errors.
toeic_zh: 訂單在處理前經過驗證以防止錯誤。

en: To sell things, often from a machine.
toeic: Licensed street merchants may vend food near the stadium.
toeic_zh: 有執照的街頭商人可在體育場附近販售食物。

en: to prove or confirm the truth of something
simple: We verify all orders before shipping.
simple_zh: 我們在運送前驗證所有訂單。
toeic: Staff verify that shipment contents match the packing list.
toeic_zh: 員工驗證貨運內容與包裝清單相符。

en: a large building for storing goods
simple: The warehouse is located near the port.
toeic: We use automated systems in our warehouse for efficient inventory management.
toeic_zh: 我們在倉庫中使用自動化系統進行有效的庫存管理。

en: In all parts of the world.
simple_zh: 這首歌在全世界都有名。
toeic: Our products are sold worldwide through local distributors.
toeic_zh: 我們的產品透過當地經銷商在全球銷售。

en: the distribution or assignment of resources
toeic: Inventory allocation ensures fairness when stock is limited.
toeic_zh: 庫存配置在庫存有限時確保公平。

en: a basic product that is bought and sold in large amounts
toeic: Rising commodity prices have increased our production costs this quarter.
toeic_zh: 大宗商品價格上漲提高了我們本季的生產成本。

en: to combine multiple shipments into one
simple: We consolidate orders to save on shipping costs.
simple_zh: 我們合併訂單以節省運送成本。
toeic: Shipping companies consolidate multiple shipments to reduce transportation costs.
toeic_zh: 運送公司合併多個貨運以降低運輸成本。

en: easy to break or damage
simple: Be careful. The glass is fragile.
toeic: Fragile items must be packed with extra protective material.
toeic_zh: 易碎物品必須用額外的保護材料包裝。
family: fragility (n); handle with care 小心輕放

en: a load carried over a distance, or the trip itself
simple: It was a long haul by truck.
simple_zh: 那趟卡車運輸路程很長。
toeic: Long-haul shipments are cheaper by rail than by road.
toeic_zh: 長途運輸走鐵路比走公路便宜。

en: basic systems and facilities
toeic: Robust infrastructure supports efficient operations.
toeic_zh: 強大的基礎設施支持高效運營。

en: the management of goods transport and storage
simple: Logistics is crucial for our business operations.
simple_zh: 物流對我們的業務運營至關重要。
toeic: Our logistics team coordinates warehousing, distribution, and customer delivery.
toeic_zh: 我們的物流團隊協調倉儲、分配和客戶交付。

en: the process of obtaining goods or services
toeic: Strategic procurement reduces costs and improves quality.
toeic_zh: 戰略性採購降低成本並提高品質。

en: a written statement of the price for goods or services
simple: I asked for a quotation today.
toeic: Please send us a quotation for 200 office chairs by Friday.
toeic_zh: 請在週五前寄給我們兩百張辦公椅的報價單。

en: discarded material or waste
toeic: Scrap rates indicate manufacturing quality issues.
toeic_zh: 廢料率表示製造品質問題。

en: an amount that is less than what is needed
simple: We have a shortfall of ten boxes.
toeic: A supplier delay caused a shortfall in our spring inventory.
toeic_zh: 供應商延誤造成我們春季庫存短缺。

en: an amount that is more than what is needed
simple: We have a surplus of rice.
toeic: The factory sold its surplus stock at a discount.
toeic_zh: 工廠把剩餘庫存打折出售。
family: surplus (adj); surplus stock 剩餘庫存；trade surplus 貿易順差

en: a tax or fee on goods
simple: The tariff on imported electronics is very high.
simple_zh: 進口電子產品的稅率非常高。
toeic: Import tariffs affect the final cost of products to consumers.
toeic_zh: 進口稅率影響產品對消費者的最終成本。

en: A formal agreement between countries.
simple: The two countries signed a treaty.
toeic: The trade treaty lowered import taxes on many goods.
toeic_zh: 這項貿易條約降低了許多商品的進口稅。

en: being the only one
simple: He is the sole owner of the shop.
simple_zh: 他是這家店唯一的老闆。
toeic: Our firm is the sole distributor of this product in Asia.
toeic_zh: 本公司是此產品在亞洲的獨家經銷商。

en: a state of complete confusion
toeic: The system failure caused chaos at the airport.
toeic_zh: 系統故障使機場陷入一片混亂。

en: to make something seem necessary or right
simple_zh: 這個問題值得我們注意。
toeic: The results warrant further investigation by the committee.
toeic_zh: 這些結果有必要由委員會進一步調查。

en: a written statement of rules or a rented vehicle
simple: The club has a written charter.
simple_zh: 這個俱樂部有一份書面章程。
toeic: We booked a charter flight for the company trip.
toeic_zh: 我們為公司旅遊預訂了一班包機。

en: exactly the same
toeic: Please confirm that both copies of the contract are identical.
toeic_zh: 請確認合約的兩份副本完全相同。

en: the act of sorting things into groups
simple: The classification of books takes time.
toeic: Each item needs a correct tariff classification before shipping.
toeic_zh: 每件商品出貨前都需要正確的關稅分類。

en: the business of flying aircraft
toeic: Aviation fuel costs have risen sharply this year.
toeic_zh: 今年航空燃油成本大幅上升。

en: a large round container for liquids
simple: The barrel is full of oil.
toeic: Oil prices rose to 90 dollars a barrel.
toeic_zh: 油價漲到每桶九十美元。

en: to press something so hard that it breaks
toeic: Heavy cartons can crush the goods at the bottom.
toeic_zh: 沉重的紙箱可能壓壞最底層的貨品。

en: a thin ball of air inside liquid
toeic: Bubble wrap protects the glass items during shipping.
toeic_zh: 氣泡紙在運送期間保護玻璃製品。

en: straight up and down
toeic: The vertical shelves save space in the warehouse.
toeic_zh: 直立式貨架節省倉庫空間。

en: very strong, unpleasant, or severe
toeic: Harsh weather conditions delayed the construction work.
toeic_zh: 惡劣的天氣狀況延誤了施工。

en: a failure to follow a rule or agreement
simple: That is a breach of the rules.
toeic: The late delivery was a breach of contract.
toeic_zh: 延遲交貨違反了合約。

en: an aircraft with spinning blades on top
simple: A helicopter flew over the city.
simple_zh: 一架直升機飛過這座城市。
toeic: The resort offers helicopter tours of the island.
toeic_zh: 度假村提供搭乘直升機遊覽該島的行程。

en: an official statement; a list of goods or income
simple: He made a declaration at the airport.
toeic: Travelers must fill out a customs declaration before landing.
toeic_zh: 旅客必須在降落前填寫海關申報單。

en: a person or device that receives something
simple: Pick up the receiver and call him.
toeic: The receiver of the package must sign for it.
toeic_zh: 包裹的收件人必須簽收。

en: similar enough to be compared
simple: The two phones are comparable in price.
simple_zh: 這兩支手機的價格相當。
toeic: Our prices are comparable to those of our competitors.
toeic_zh: 我們的價格與競爭對手相當。

en: a central place where activity or traffic meets
simple: The airport is a big hub.
simple_zh: 這座機場是個大型樞紐。
toeic: Singapore serves as a regional hub for our shipping network.
toeic_zh: 新加坡是我們貨運網絡的區域樞紐。

en: certain to happen and impossible to stop
toeic: Some delays are inevitable during the busy holiday season.
toeic_zh: 在繁忙的假期旺季，部分延誤是無可避免的。

en: one of the world's large land areas
toeic: Our company now ships products to every continent.
toeic_zh: 我們公司現在把產品運送到每個大洲。

en: a grid or table of rows and columns
simple: The teacher drew a matrix on the board.
simple_zh: 老師在黑板上畫了一個矩陣。
toeic: We used a decision matrix to compare the suppliers.
toeic_zh: 我們用決策矩陣來比較各家供應商。

en: having many detailed parts; carefully planned
simple_zh: 他們做了一個精緻的蛋糕。
toeic: The hotel lobby has an elaborate design with marble floors.
toeic_zh: 這家飯店的大廳設計精細，鋪有大理石地板。

en: complete and total; very steep
toeic: The sheer size of the order surprised the warehouse team.
toeic_zh: 這筆訂單的龐大規模讓倉儲團隊感到驚訝。

en: not valid; completely empty
simple: The ticket is void after today.
simple_zh: 這張票今天之後就失效了。
toeic: The contract will be void if either party breaks the terms.
toeic_zh: 若任何一方違反條款，合約即告無效。

en: to balance or cancel the effect of something
simple: Savings can offset the high price.
simple_zh: 省下的錢可以抵銷高價。
toeic: Lower shipping costs helped offset the rise in raw material prices.
toeic_zh: 較低的運費有助於抵銷原料價格的上漲。

en: the study of the earth, countries and land
toeic: Knowledge of local geography helps us plan delivery routes.
toeic_zh: 了解當地地理有助於我們規劃配送路線。

en: related to the physical features of a place
toeic: The company is expanding into a new geographic region.
toeic_zh: 該公司正擴展到新的地理區域。

en: according to what people believe, but maybe not true
toeic: The supposedly cheaper supplier ended up costing us more.
toeic_zh: 那家據稱比較便宜的供應商最後讓我們花了更多錢。

en: the main part of a country, not nearby islands
simple: We took a boat to the mainland.
toeic: The factory ships goods from the island to the mainland daily.
toeic_zh: 工廠每天將貨物從島上運到本土。

en: quickly and easily, or willingly
toeic: Our products are readily available in most stores.
toeic_zh: 我們的產品在大多數商店都很容易買到。

en: harmful or unfavorable
simple: The weather had an adverse effect.
toeic: Adverse weather conditions delayed the shipment by two days.
toeic_zh: 惡劣天候使貨物延誤了兩天。

en: a desire for food or for something
toeic: Investors showed little appetite for risky stocks this quarter.
toeic_zh: 本季投資人對高風險股票興趣不高。

en: To arrange something dishonestly or equip it
simple: They tried to rig the vote.
toeic: The company was accused of trying to rig the bidding process.
toeic_zh: 該公司被指控試圖操縱投標程序。

en: A person or company that builds houses or buildings
simple_zh: 建築工人修好了我們的屋頂。
toeic: The builder promised to finish the office by June.
toeic_zh: 建築商承諾六月前完成辦公室。

en: Related to the land and places of the world
toeic: The store chose the location for its geographical advantages.
toeic_zh: 這家店因地理優勢而選擇這個地點。

en: An official order from a government
toeic: A new decree bans the import of certain chemicals.
toeic_zh: 一項新法令禁止進口某些化學品。

en: In all parts of the world
toeic: The brand is recognized globally for its quality.
toeic_zh: 該品牌因品質而受到全球認可。

en: A sudden strong increase
simple: There was a surge in sales.
toeic: A surge in demand caused shipping delays.
toeic_zh: 需求激增造成出貨延誤。

en: The state of depending on something
simple: Our reliance on him is high.
toeic: The firm's reliance on one supplier is a serious risk.
toeic_zh: 公司依賴單一供應商是個嚴重風險。

en: To take hold of something suddenly or by force
toeic: Customs officers seized the illegal goods at the port.
toeic_zh: 海關人員在港口查扣了違禁貨物。

en: To the amount needed
toeic: The cargo was not sufficiently protected during shipping.
toeic_zh: 貨物在運送過程中沒有受到充分保護。

en: Something that reduces the effect of a shock
toeic: Extra inventory acts as a buffer against supply problems.
toeic_zh: 額外庫存可作為供應問題的緩衝。

en: Measured by comparing with something else
toeic: A comparative analysis of both suppliers will help us decide.
toeic_zh: 對兩家供應商的比較分析將有助於我們決定。

en: To support something so that it stays up
toeic: Workers used a beam to prop up the damaged wall.
toeic_zh: 工人用樑柱支撐受損的牆。

en: A person who watches something
toeic: The program attracted over a million viewers last night.
toeic_zh: 這個節目昨晚吸引了超過一百萬名觀眾。

en: a man who works for the police
simple: The policeman helped us find the street.
simple_zh: 警察幫我們找到那條街。
toeic: A policeman directed traffic outside the hotel after the accident.
toeic_zh: 事故發生後，一名警察在飯店外指揮交通。

en: involving two sides or countries
simple: The two countries signed a bilateral deal.
toeic: The bilateral trade agreement will lower tariffs for both countries.
toeic_zh: 這項雙邊貿易協定將降低兩國的關稅。

en: not in a direct way
simple_zh: 我是間接聽到這個消息的。
toeic: Rising fuel prices indirectly affect the cost of all our products.
toeic_zh: 燃料價格上漲間接影響我們所有產品的成本。

en: in a way that is surprising
toeic: The flight was unexpectedly canceled because of bad weather.
toeic_zh: 班機因天候不佳意外取消。

en: not ready or happy to do something
toeic: The supplier was unwilling to lower its prices.
toeic_zh: 供應商不願意降價。

en: the state of being legal or correct
simple: Check the validity of your ticket.
simple_zh: 請確認你的票是否有效。
toeic: Please check the validity of your passport before you travel.
toeic_zh: 出發前請確認你的護照是否仍有效。

en: not possible to know in advance
toeic: Fuel costs are unpredictable, which makes budgeting difficult.
toeic_zh: 燃料成本難以預測，使預算編列困難。

en: a person who talks about news or sports
simple: The commentator talked about the game.
toeic: A financial commentator explained the market trends on the evening news.
toeic_zh: 一位財經評論員在晚間新聞中解釋市場趨勢。

en: a small hollow made by hitting a surface
simple: There is a dent in my car.
toeic: The delivered box had a dent, so the customer asked for a refund.
toeic_zh: 送達的箱子有凹痕，所以客戶要求退款。

en: to pay back money you owe
toeic: The firm must repay the loan within five years.
toeic_zh: 公司必須在五年內償還這筆貸款。

en: failure to take proper care
simple: The accident was caused by negligence.
simple_zh: 這起意外是疏忽造成的。
toeic: The company was fined for negligence in maintaining safety equipment.
toeic_zh: 公司因疏於維護安全設備而被罰款。

en: not enough in supply
toeic: Skilled workers are scarce in this region.
toeic_zh: 這個地區缺乏技術工人。

en: the gradual gathering of things
simple: The accumulation of snow closed the road.
toeic: The accumulation of debt worried the board.
toeic_zh: 債務的累積讓董事會擔憂。

en: to stop something before it arrives
simple: The guard will intercept the man.
toeic: Customs officers intercepted the illegal shipment at the port.
toeic_zh: 海關人員在港口攔截了非法貨物。

en: in agreement with a rule or contract
simple: We act pursuant to the rules.
toeic: Pursuant to the contract, payment is due within thirty days.
toeic_zh: 依照合約，款項須在三十天內支付。

en: to make something less harmful
toeic: We took steps to mitigate the risk of delays.
toeic_zh: 我們採取措施來降低延誤的風險。

en: limiting what people can do
toeic: The contract includes restrictive conditions on resale.
toeic_zh: 合約中包含轉售的限制條件。

en: a careful or clever movement or action
simple: The driver made a quick maneuver.
simple_zh: 司機迅速做了個閃避動作。
toeic: The firm made a clever maneuver to enter the market.
toeic_zh: 這家公司採取了巧妙策略進入市場。

en: to exchange a coupon for something
simple: I will redeem this coupon today.
simple_zh: 我今天要兌換這張優惠券。
toeic: Customers can redeem their points for free gifts.
toeic_zh: 顧客可以用點數兌換贈品。

en: the state of needing someone or something
simple: His dependency on coffee is strong.
toeic: The firm wants to reduce its dependency on one supplier.
toeic_zh: 公司想降低對單一供應商的依賴。

en: not sure or unlikely
simple: It is doubtful that he will come.
toeic: It is doubtful that the shipment will arrive on time.
toeic_zh: 貨物是否能準時送達很令人懷疑。

en: to talk proudly about what you have
simple: He likes to boast about his car.
toeic: The hotel boasts a beautiful view of the sea.
toeic_zh: 這家飯店擁有迷人的海景。

en: based on guessing, often risky for money
toeic: The fund avoids speculative investments in new technology.
toeic_zh: 該基金避開對新科技的投機性投資。

en: to increase greatly in number
toeic: Our profits could multiply if we expand overseas.
toeic_zh: 如果我們拓展海外，利潤可能倍增。
